messages:
noah: Quick sync 1: were launching a tiny OSS refapp + micro-tutorial next Wed. goal: drive dev signups and collect 50 webinar RSVPs. Need clear owners for: launch post (blog + HN blurb), benchmark one-slide, 15-min demo script, RSVP/thank-you flow, and inbound routing into CRM. whos in for which? :raising_hand:

katie: I can draft the blog + HN blurb. want 2 angles: hands-on tutorial (how-to) and bench-led (cost/latency). will prep both and we can pick.

raj: Ill do the benchmark narrative and the one-slide. planning a small chart: median p50/p95 latency + $/k tokens. will run on small 2-GPU Dedicated sim and a hosted profile.

ellie: Ill own RSVP flow and the automated thank-you email. propose capturing `utm_source=refapp_launch` + `referral=community` and include a one-click calendar add. also happy to wire the Zapier -> CRM mapping.

noah: perfect. for inbound routing: if company_size > 100 or role contains "platform" send to AE queue; else to SDR nurture. raj/katie s bench copy needs to include an inline callout: "Tested with 512 tokens, batching=4".

katie: noted. will include a short methods blurb. also drafting a teaser tweet thread and 3 hero variants for the site: technical, outcome, playful.

raj: benchmark ETA: tomorrow EOD. ill paste a tiny table here and attach image in the ticket.

ellie: routing rules: grab `job_title` from signup form, if empty try LinkedIn lookup in the Zap, otherwise fallback to `unknown`. Tag leads with `refapp:mar24`.

promo-bot: Created ticket MK-5009: "RefApp microlaunch - checklist & assets" assigned: katie, raj, ellie. Reminder set for 48h before launch.

noah: messaging experiment: well A/B test hero variants for 72h then promote winning variant into paid. KPI: CTR->RSVP > 2.5% target.

katie: Ill put all copy into the ticket and label drafts with `copy/v1, copy/v2, copy/v3`. also share short preview images.

ellie: on the thank-you email, want a 1-click quickstart link to the GitHub refapp and a short 2-step runbook. ill include UTM'd links.

raj: posting note for the demo script: keep it under 15m, show setup, 60s real-time demo of an edge case (long context), then the bench slide. will write a 3-bullet script.

noah: great. next steps: owners confirm by EOD. planning call Mon 10:00 PT to walk through slides and RSVP page. post any blockers here. :calendar:

katie: confirmed, will upload drafts.

ellie: confirmed, will share Zapier flow.

raj: confirmed, will add raw numbers to the ticket and a PNG.

noah: thanks team 389 - see you on Mon.
